description: This file implements the code-behind for the ExamResult page in an online examination system. It handles displaying exam results, updating user statistics such as total marks and number of exams taken in the database, and managing navigation buttons.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page, manages page load logic and navigation button actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieves session data, updates the database with the user's latest exam results, calculates averages, and populates UI controls with session data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out by redirecting to the Login page.
